description: This file implements a WebSocket connection manager using FastAPI and asyncio, handling multiple WebSocket connections for projects and tasks, with functionalities for connecting, disconnecting, and broadcasting messages to rooms associated with project and task identifiers.

classes.name: _Room
classes.description: Represents a set of active WebSocket connections associated with a specific project or task.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for multiple projects and tasks, providing methods to connect, disconnect, and broadcast messages.

methods.name: _Room.connect
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and adds it to the room.

methods.name: _Room.disconnect
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket from the room.

methods.name: _Room.broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket connections in the room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager with dictionaries for project and task rooms and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager._get_room
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a room in the specified container for a given key.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.connect_project
methods.description: Connects a WebSocket to a project's room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.disconnect_project
methods.description: Disconnects a WebSocket from a project's room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.connect_task
methods.description: Connects a WebSocket to a task's room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.disconnect_task
methods.description: Disconnects a WebSocket from a task's room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.broadcast_project
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSockets in a project's room.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager.broadcast_task
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSockets in a task's room.
